title: 第25章 我要死了第26章 这全是他斩杀的
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: 一声令人头皮发麻的闷响。
那一击蕴含几千巨力的冲击，狠狠撞在那镖师的脑袋上。
没有惨叫，甚至没有挣扎。
他的头颅就像一个熟透的西瓜，瞬间爆碎开来，红的白的溅了一地。
不等众人前去抢夺尸身，周围那些状若疯狂的寄怨魔猿便一拥而上，锋利的爪牙瞬间将那具无头尸体撕扯得稀巴烂！
众人双目赤红，准备去救援另一人。
然而，又是一阵铺天盖的树干雨呼啸而来，将他们救援的路线彻底封死。
砰砰！”
在包围圈里的另一名镖师，身形连续被三根巨木撞中，骨骼碎裂接连响起。
他来不及发出一声惨叫，大口鲜血从口鼻中狂喷而出，瞬间丧失战力。
下一秒，他便被如潮水般涌上的魔猿彻底淹没，分尸当场。
洛璃看到这血腥恐怖的一幕，惊叫一声。
紧接着，胃里一阵翻江倒海，忍不住扶着斩马刀剧烈地干呕起来。
她虽然在山里长大，但平时杀鸡都没见过。
哪里经得住这活生生的人被这些畜生分食。
“兄弟们！
给老刘、老王报仇！
罗通此刻老脸漆黑如墨，双眼布满血丝。
他将所有的悲愤与怒火都灌注在手中的长刀之上。
每落下的一刀，都带着开山裂石的决绝！
每一声怒吼，都饱含着对同伴逝去的无尽悲痛，完全放弃了防守，以伤换伤，以命换命！
陈观冷冷地瞟了他们一眼，便没有再关注。
因为他注意到，那些混杂在魔猿群中的另一批怪物，酝酿的第三波攻击，即将到来。
“赵五！
小心！
人群中不知谁惨呼一声。
洛璃顺着声音看去，只见之前那个对陈观颐指气使，名为赵五的魁梧老头，此刻竟然被两头寄怨魔猿死死踩在地上，动弹不得。
而远处，那头体型最为硕大的魔猿首领，双腿猛地一蹬，直接冲天而起，一蹦便是七八丈高，如同一座下坠的山岳，朝着地上的赵五狠狠踩去！
“陈观！
你还愣着干什么，快去救他啊！”
洛璃急得大喊。
然而，陈观却像是没听见一般，依旧如一尊石像，注视着前方的丛林。
content_en:
;;
"Bang!
! "
There was a numbing sound.
That blow contained an impact of thousands of giants and hit the escort's head hard.
There was no scream, not even a struggle.
His head was like a ripe watermelon, instantly bursting open and red and white splattering all over the floor.
Before anyone could go to snatch the body, the crazy-looking demon apes surrounding them swarmed up, and their sharp claws tore the headless corpse to pieces in an instant!
"grass!"
Everyone's eyes were red, ready to rescue another person.
However, another overwhelming rain of tree trunks roared in, completely blocking their rescue route.
"Bang!
Bang bang! "
Another bodyguard in the encirclement was hit by three giant trees in succession, and his bones cracked one after another.
Before he could let out a scream, a large mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth and nose, and he lost his fighting power instantly.
The next second, he was completely submerged by the demonic apes that surged up like a tide, and his body was cut into pieces on the spot.
"Ah——!"
Luo Li screamed when she saw this bloody and terrifying scene.
Immediately afterwards, my stomach was churning, and I couldn't help but hold on to my sword and retched violently.
Although she grew up in the mountains, she has never seen chickens killed.
How can a living person withstand being devoured by these beasts?
"Brothers!
Avenge Lao Liu and Lao Wang!
! "
Luo Tong's old face was as dark as ink at this moment, and his eyes were bloodshot.
He poured all his grief and anger into the long knife in his hand.
Every falling sword carries the determination to break mountains and crack rocks!
Every roar was filled with endless grief for the loss of his companions. He completely gave up his defense, trading injuries for injuries, and trading lives for lives!
Chen Guan glanced at them coldly and stopped paying attention.
Because he noticed that the third wave of attacks brewed by another group of monsters mixed in the group of demon apes was about to come.
“Zhao Wu!
Be careful!
! "
Someone in the crowd screamed miserably.
Luo Li followed the sound and saw that the burly old man named Zhao Wu who had been bossing Chen Guanyi around was now being trampled to the ground by two grudge demon apes, unable to move.
In the distance, the largest demon ape leader suddenly kicked his legs and shot up into the sky. He jumped seven or eight feet high, like a falling mountain, and stepped hard towards Zhao Wu on the ground!
"Chen Guan!
What are you still doing? Go and save him! "
Luo Li shouted anxiously.
However, Chen Guan seemed not to hear it, and remained like a stone statue, staring at the jungle ahead.
